Dear Investors 🤝,

Here is your monthly update for February 2026
📉 @Short-Tech — February 2026 Pulse
Monthly: +6.83% 🚀
YTD: +6.51%

Short-Tech delivered a strong February, as tech headwinds and a rotation into hard assets powered the portfolio higher. Crypto, precious metals, and selective equity exposure all contributed to a standout month 💪.

February saw renewed pressure on growth-oriented tech names, playing directly into the portfolio's core thesis 🎯. As rate uncertainty lingered and macro sentiment shifted, investors rotated away from stretched valuations in the technology sector — creating fertile ground for Short-Tech's positioning to shine ✨.

Meanwhile, the portfolio's exposure to Bitcoin and Coinbase captured the crypto market's resilience 🔥, while gold and silver holdings via $WGLD.L, $SLVR.L, and $WSLV.L acted as a powerful hedge against broader equity volatility 🛡️. NVIDIA and Apple remained key watchpoints, with the market closely scrutinizing AI spending narratives and consumer demand signals heading into Q1 📊.

With tech sector sentiment remaining fragile and precious metals continuing to attract safe-haven flows, Short-Tech looks well-positioned as we move deeper into 2026 🚀.
